aspects.says: Only an unlock and a later lock of the same monitor, a volatile write and a later read of the same field, start() and the started thread, and a thread's end and a join on it connect two threads.
basis: section:Four Pairs of Actions Connect Two Threads, and Transitivity Chains Them

aspects.says: The JLS also orders interrupt() before its detection, a thread's end before isAlive() returns false, and default values before every thread's first action.
basis: section:Four Pairs of Actions Connect Two Threads, and Transitivity Chains Them
aspects.reason: a hedged side note from the JLS with no example on the page; interruption is practised in unit 6.1.3

aspects.says: A thread's writes happen-before another thread's return from join only when the join returns because the thread ended; a join that timed out gives no edge.
basis: section:A Read Is Guaranteed to See a Write Only If the Write Happens-Before It

aspects.says: Happens-before never makes a thread wait for another; waiting needs a loop, a join or a java.util.concurrent class.
basis: section:Happens-Before Is Not Time: a Write Seconds Earlier Can Stay Invisible
aspects.reason: a statement of what the model does not do; there is no behaviour of the reader's code that a test could observe to check it

aspects.says: A write made earlier by the clock is not ordered before a read, and may stay invisible; waiting, sleeping or timestamps create no edge.
basis: section:Happens-Before Is Not Time: a Write Seconds Earlier Can Stay Invisible

aspects.says: Plain writes made before one edge-forming write are carried by that edge, so the fields handed over need no volatile of their own.
basis: section:An Edge Carries Every Write Made Before It, Only to Code After Its Other End

aspects.says: A reader gets the carried writes only in code after its volatile read, lock or join; a plain read made before the volatile read can return a stale value.
basis: section:Spot the Problem: Reading the Payload Before the Flag

aspects.says: start() orders the writes made before the call, not those the starting thread makes after it.
basis: section:Four Pairs of Actions Connect Two Threads, and Transitivity Chains Them

aspects.says: Happens-before is transitive, so a write reaches a thread that never took part in the first edge of a chain.
basis: section:Four Pairs of Actions Connect Two Threads, and Transitivity Chains Them

aspects.says: A read is guaranteed to see another thread's write only if the write happens-before it; without an edge the read is a data race and may return an older value.
basis: section:A Read Is Guaranteed to See a Write Only If the Write Happens-Before It
